cases.scenario: Logged-in user downloads CSV containing their data
steps: Log in as a user with at least one data record
cases.expected: A CSV file downloads containing every data record visible to the user, with the standard header row

cases.scenario: Logged-in user with zero records downloads CSV
steps: Log in as a freshly created user with no data records
cases.expected: A CSV file with only the header row downloads; status code is 200

cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request to CSV endpoint is rejected
steps: Without a session cookie or bearer token, send GET /data/export.csv
cases.expected: Response is HTTP 401 Unauthorized; the response body contains no CSV content
